title: Snake & Ladder
summary: Board validation, injected dice, exact-finish rule, extra turn on a six and the three-sixes penalty. A machine-coding favourite.
hints: Store snakes and ladders in **one** `Map<Integer,Integer> jumps`. The game doesn't care which kind it is, only the board does when validating.
Inject the dice. Tests pass a scripted sequence, which is why `Dice` is an interface.
Track `turnStart` (position before the current player's first roll this turn) and `sixes` (consecutive sixes). Reset both when the turn passes to the next player.
Order of a move: overshoot → stay. Otherwise move, then apply a jump if one exists, then check for a win. Then decide who plays next.
